researchLog.note: Imported from the project handoff (research rounds 1–3, Oct 2026).
Name in the Ancestry tree: "Elizabeth Brill"; research uses "Elizabeth Meier".
Death in the Ancestry tree: 12 May 1948; research: 1945.
Confidence confirmed → probable: The death date rests only on an unsourced tree entry, and the state index shows no matching Meier.
Round 4 searched without result: PA Death Index 1945 M600 block (no Elizabeth Meier/Meyer, Hazleton)
Round 4: FS gives death 12 May 1945 Hazleton, but she is not in the 1945 PA death index under Meier/Meyer.

bio: FamilySearch gives her death as 12 May 1945 at Hazleton ([R4-S1]); the tree had only the year. A search of the 1945 Pennsylvania death index (M–O volume, Soundex M600 block, pp.178–179) found no Elizabeth Meier/Meyer/Mayer dying in May 1945 at Hazleton ([R4-S2]). She may have died under a married name, or the date may be wrong.
openQuestions: Did she marry? No Meier entry fits in the 1945 PA death index, which suggests a married surname. Check the 1900–1940 Hazleton censuses.
